headline: Bonds up to $900,000 for a 14 Mulberry Street resource center, and rehabilitation of Taylor Falls and Veterans bridges.
summary: Two Million Dollar contract awards are on the agenda, one for Allegiance Fire & Rescue and one for Sanitary Equipment. A 2026 Kenworth T280 service truck and a housing agreement with Harbor Homes, Inc. are also listed.
items: Request from the Board of Fire Commissioners to convene a Joint Committee on Infrastructure and Fire Commission
Million Dollar Contract Award - Allegiance Fire & Rescue
Million Dollar Contract Award - Sanitary Equipment
Public comment on items expected to be acted on this evening
Budget Review Committee reports from 10/6/26 and 10/26/26

R-26-080: Amend Section 7 of the Economic Development Initiative and Community Development Block Grant agreement with Harbor Homes, Inc. to allow transitional and permanent housing for non-veterans and their families (Human Affairs Committee recommends final passage)

R-26-020: Bonds not to exceed $900,000 for the purchase, design, pre-renovation work and renovations of a resource center at 14 Mulberry Street (tabled at the 4/22/26 Special Board of Aldermen meeting)

R-26-081: Federal Bridge Aid Program project agreement with the State of New Hampshire and the Town of Hudson to rehabilitate the Taylor Falls and Veterans Bridges, and a related reimbursement agreement with the Town of Hudson
